summary: Actionable, high-fidelity visual guidelines for refining Anjana Sara Abraham's portfolio. Preserves the authentic consulting aesthetic (deep obsidian-navy, Playfair Display + IBM Plex Sans, restrained teal/lavender/warm accents, asymmetric sticky rail, coordinate grid, and strict truth in data) while implementing five critical refinements: (1) uploaded professional portrait in the Hero profile panel only with deliberate crop; (2) reduced vertical gaps while maintaining editorial breathing room; (3) Musafir and SPMS side-by-side as two equal project cards; (4) Bayer as a separate, more prominent ongoing live-project spotlight; (5) prominent 'My Resume' hero action; (6) first-person narrative voice throughout Hero and About.

1_hero_profile_portrait.placement: Hero profile panel only (replacing the placeholder poster monogram in .hero-visual while preserving the coordinate grid backdrop and metadata stamps).
rules: Do NOT use stock photography personas elsewhere in the portfolio.
Apply a premium deliberate crop: container aspect-ratio ~4:5 or 3:4, object-cover with object-position: center top (focus on face & shoulders).
Encase portrait in a refined 1px border (border-white/20 with subtle teal ambient glow shadow-[0_16px_36px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]).
Include elegant lower third scrim / badge overlay with 'ASA • ANJANA SARA ABRAHAM' and 'Business Analysis / Transformation' label.
Maintain the surrounding coordinate grid, tactical stamps ('PROFILE / 01', 'SYSTEMS THINKING', 'DATA / 03', 'DECISION / 07', 'ACTION / 12').

2_vertical_gap_reduction.problem: Current padding (146px - 170px vertical) creates excessive dead space and forces unnecessary scrolling between dense analytical content blocks.
2_vertical_gap_reduction.solution: Calibrate section padding to an intentional editorial standard (py-16 to py-20 / 72px-90px on desktop, 48px-60px on mobile).

spacing_scale_overrides.sticky_rail_top: top: 96px (sticky offset aligned with reduced header/section rhythm)

3_project_cards_layout.structure: Asymmetric 2-tier layout: 2 equal side-by-side case study cards (Musafir & SPMS) + 1 prominent ongoing live project banner (Bayer).

musafir_and_spms_layout.card_styling: Equal 50/50 flex/grid columns with matching height, 1px border-white/10, surface bg #0E1626, hover lift (-translate-y-1), and identical typography hierarchy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refine the existing App.js and App.css — do NOT rebuild from scratch and do NOT invent any fake corporate case studies, clients, degrees, or awards.

Edit 1 (Hero Portrait): Place the uploaded professional portrait in the Hero profile panel only (.portrait-poster inside .hero-visual). Apply a premium deliberate crop (aspect-ratio 4:5, object-cover, centered top). Keep the technical coordinate grid and metadata labels around it. Do NOT insert stock photos anywhere else.

Edit 2 (Vertical Gaps): Reduce excessive section paddings (from 146px/170px down to 82px desktop / 56px mobile) and internal module tops (from 62px down to 36px) while preserving clear editorial breathing room and the sticky left rail rhythm.

Edit 3 (Projects Layout): In the Projects section, place Musafir and SPMS side-by-side as two equal project cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2). Give Bayer a separate, more prominent ongoing live-project spotlight card (full width, pulsing live indicator, distinct gradient elevation, 'LISTEN → ANALYZE → RECOMMEND' flow).
Edit 4 (Hero Resume CTA): Add a prominent 'My Resume' action in the Hero actions button group (alongside 'View My Work' and 'Let's Connect') with data-testid='hero-resume-button'.

Edit 5 (First-Person Copy): Update all biographical text in the Hero intro and About section to first-person ('I am an impact-oriented professional...', 'My work sits at the intersection...', 'I bring structure...').
Ensure the marquee ticker has zero horizontal page overflow (contain: paint, overflow: hidden on .marquee-viewport).
Preserve all data-testid attributes exactly as specified to ensure test suites pass without breaking.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not center-align the app container. Maintain the authentic asymmetric Swiss layout with sticky left rail and crisp hairline borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use 'transition: all'. Explicitly specify transitions like 'transition: transform 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Ensure every text string meets WCAG AA standards. Always set explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-teal-400 hover:text-slate-950).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_assistant_emojis: Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭💡🔮) for icons. Use Lucide icons (FileText, ArrowUpRight, Activity, Database, Workflow, Target, etc.).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.truth_in_data: Preserve Anjana's exact career history, projects, metrics, and certifications without embellishment or fictional client names.
